name: Vajrapani Embroidered Mount with Garuda
material: Opaque watercolor, gold, and silver on silk
summary: The painting depicts the Buddhist protector who holds (pani) the thunder bolt (vajra) in his right hand. He kneels in reverence and holds his left hand in a gesture of salute. This unusual image appears to have been the vision of a Tibetan monastic patriarch known for creating his own inventive pain
